newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shorts hug BoGr's 13.40pct offer, squeeze on.
newsitem.headline: Greek shorts hug BoGr's 13.40pct offer, squeeze on.

text.p: The Bank of Greece extended a helping hand to local banks to remedy a liquidity shortage with an injection of overnight cash at 13.40 percent and an overnight repo but shorts firmed a bit, dealers said.

"Shorts have firmed again after dipping early in the day on hopes of a receding liquidity shortage that proved unfounded," said a trader at a state bank. "The central bank has really done everything in its power to alleviate the problem."

The central bank intervened at 13.40 percent to boost liquidity and essentially provided a comfortable credit line to local banks via an overnight repo by accepting all kinds of state debt paper as collateral, the trader said.
There was little action at the central bank's fixing, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 157.84/89 drachmas from Wednesday's 157.890 fix, the dollar at 240.61/71 drachmas from 240.630 and the Ecu at 301.05/15 from 301.240 drachmas.
